SELECT vhsv.id, vhsv.search_id, vhsv.video_id, vhsv.influencer_platform_type, vhsv.influencer_platform_user_id, vhsv.influencer_nickname, vhsv.influencer_avatar, vhsv.influencer_followers_count, vhsv.sort_order, vhsv.created_date, vhsv.update_date, vhsv.is_deleted FROM tb_video_hot_search_video vhsv INNER JOIN tb_video_hot_search vhs ON vhsv.search_id = vhs.id WHERE vhs.platform_type = #{platformType} AND vhs.search_keyword = #{searchKeyword} AND vhs.is_deleted = 0 AND vhsv.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY vhsv.sort_order DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
